name: mcpcap
title: mcpcap (PCAP analysis)
description: Analyzes packet captures (.pcap, .pcapng, .cap) with scapy: DNS, DHCP, ICMP, SIP, TCP connections, anomalies, retransmissions, traffic flows and capinfos-style statistics. Files are read from the folder mounted at /work (tools take /work/<file>). No network.

mounts.description: The folder with the capture files (read-only is enough)

notes: mcpcap can also download a capture from an http(s) URL; with no network (the default) that fails, which is intended.
